name: @nest-mediator/core
description: A lightweight CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation) mediator pattern implementation for NestJS applications with optional event sourcing on PostgreSQL or SQL Server
author: Roland Salloum

scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:major: npm version major && npm publish --access public
scripts.test:library: npm run build && npm run test:types && vitest run --config vitest.library.config.mts
scripts.test:command-results: npm run build && vitest run test/runtime/command-results.test.ts --config vitest.library.config.mts && npm run test:types
scripts.test:timestamps: npm run build && vitest run test/runtime/timestamp-schemas.test.ts --config vitest.library.config.mts
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:resilience && npm run test:integration:postgres
scripts.test:integration:all: npm run test:integration && npm run test:integration:sqlserver
scripts.test:resilience: npm run build && tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json && vitest run --config vitest.resilience.config.mts
scripts.test:integration:postgres: npm run build && tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json && vitest run --config vitest.event-store.config.mts --project postgres
scripts.test:integration:sqlserver: npm run build && tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json && vitest run --config vitest.event-store.config.mts --project sqlserver
